purpose: Every toolchain the evaluator and the creator build with. sha256 of this file is toolchainManifestHash in demand/spec.json.

rust.source: rust-toolchain.toml at the pinned RSP commit; the workflows never override it

lean.elanInstall: https://elan.lean-lang.org/elan-init.sh with --default-toolchain none; the project's lean-toolchain selects the version and must equal this one

python.analysis: stdlib only for paired.py and axioms.py; freeze.py needs eth-hash for keccak256

runner.image: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 (rolling; ImageOS and ImageVersion recorded per job)
